whole_event.target: transcriptomic displacement from untreated state and return/reorganization after perturbation removal

primary_processing.expression_source: raw count columns only; deposited FPKM and differential-expression statistics are not used in the primary geometry
primary_processing.gene_identity: source gene_id; duplicate gene_id rows, if any, are summed before filtering
primary_processing.label_blind_expression_filter: retain genes with count >= 10 in at least 3 of 12 samples
primary_processing.size_factor_method: DESeq2-style median-of-ratios using positive-count geometric means (poscounts variant); no phenotype labels
primary_processing.sample_exclusion: none; all 12 frozen biological replicates remain in the primary analysis

primary_state_geometry.space: full filtered log-normalized protein-coding gene space without supervised gene selection
primary_state_geometry.condition_centroid: arithmetic mean of the three biological replicate vectors
primary_state_geometry.parallel_coordinate: q_t = dot(mu_t-mu_WT, v) / dot(v,v); q=0 at WT and q=1 at CCCP
primary_state_geometry.recovery_vector_alignment: cosine(mu_W6H-mu_CCCP, v); negative values are directionally consistent with reversal of the damage vector

uncertainty.method: nonparametric bootstrap of biological replicates independently within each of the four frozen conditions

Bio_Chi_decision.RECOVERY_TOWARD_WT_SUPPORTED_P0Q: source gate passes and the bootstrap 95% interval for R_6 is entirely above 0
Bio_Chi_decision.DIVERGENCE_FROM_WT_P0Q: bootstrap 95% interval for R_6 is entirely below 0
Bio_Chi_decision.progressive_recovery_support: reported separately only if the bootstrap 95% interval for Delta_6_1 is entirely above 0

Chi_bio_representation_test.object: the four condition centroids WT, CCCP, W1H, W6H in the same full state space
Chi_bio_representation_test.svd: center the four centroids across conditions and compute the singular spectrum
Chi_bio_representation_test.one_dimensional_adequacy: PC1 variance fraction >= 0.95 AND maximum rank-1 condition-centroid reconstruction residual divided by D_C <= 0.10
Chi_bio_representation_test.bootstrap_requirement: at least 95% of replicate-bootstrap realizations must also satisfy both one-dimensional adequacy criteria
Chi_bio_representation_test.note: one-dimensional state-path adequacy does not license scalar chi_bio

chi_bio.rule: cross-sectional replicate RNA counts do not identify a same-mode dynamical damping carrier; no scalar will be derived from mean, variance, PCA position, recovery fraction, or fitted interpolation

prespecified_sensitivities.all_gene_sensitivity: repeat the state geometry using all source biotypes passing the same label-blind count filter
prespecified_sensitivities.FPKM_sensitivity: repeat descriptive centroid geometry using log2(FPKM+1) on the same primary protein-coding gene identities; cannot replace count-normalized primary result
prespecified_sensitivities.leave_one_replicate_per_condition: enumerate 3^4 = 81 combinations selecting two of three replicates per condition by leaving one out; report distribution of R_6 and PC1 fraction

failure_rules: processed file hash mismatch stops analysis
fewer than 1000 primary protein-coding genes after the frozen filter is a source/representation failure
nonfinite size factor or zero damage distance stops the geometry
negative, unresolved, or multicoordinate outcomes are preserved and cannot be rescued by pathway selection
source-deposited differential-expression results are not used to choose the primary gene space
claim_ceiling: independent-source bulk-transcriptomic P0-Q recovery qualification in one U2OS CCCP/washout series; no causal mitochondrial repair mechanism, no universal biological chi law, and no scalar chi_bio boundary
